reason: I already pay $35 a month for TradingView Plus and track my swings in a spreadsheet, and I am not adding $49 more for quotes that may still be 10 to 20 minutes delayed.
objection: Why pay $49/mo on top of TradingView Plus when free-tier public data has a 10–20 minute delay?
would_change_my_mind: Show verified licensed data with zero delay and let the built-in journal replace my spreadsheet at $35-$39/mo.
